fact: Blackboard LMS was launched in November 2025 for BPSC digital training, with 1,172 completing the first assessment across pilot courses, and the plan targets an open-source LMS for up to 120,000 of about 125,000 public service officers.
title: Sustainable E-Learning Solution Implementation for Botswana Public Service College (BPSC)
publisher: HAUS Finnish Institute of Public Management
